reciprocal.into: P096 — Let the many become one — and be increased by one
reciprocal.why: P096 states Whitehead's formula for how a new event comes to be; P153 draws the participatory reading of the same formula, where a person's action is one of the ways the world moves past itself.

notes: P153 (p1o, 2026-10-20): reciprocal into P096 proposed; P096's page cites the same Process and Reality formula (Garland encyclopedia entry, PR p. 21) that P153's body draws on. No new concept pages needed: 'The many become one', 'Creative advance', 'Mattering' and 'Participate in the world's becoming' already list P153.
